[url=http:]2.[/url]﻿ Drop this mod inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[url=http:]3[/url][url=http:].[/url]﻿[url=http:][/url]﻿ Done! You can now have a bat companion in your game c:

[url=http:]→ [/url]﻿If you want a bat that isn't the default (black) one, run the game to generate a config.json file, then close the game. Open the config.jason file and change "Black" to color you want.
[url=http:]→ [/url] You can easily alternate between textures while in game using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Config Mod[/url]﻿.[/center][center]﻿
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hGB256Wd/Features.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]﻿[url=http:]→ [/url]﻿ Six bat colors.
